liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell In A Bucket** (2 reviews): Bucket flowed into a surprise, short Fire on the Mountain that the reviewer finds appealing; Hell In A Bucket's energy stood out for the reviewer, along with Blow Away [8][18]
- **Blow Away** (2 reviews): Blow Away stands out, ending with a strong rap from Brent; Jerry plays slide guitar on Blow Away [8][11]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says Phil's bass playing is heavy and prominent throughout the show [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-05-27.pzm.russjcan.93686.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 149 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1989-05-27.155314.ultramatrix.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1989-05-27.155440.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd1989-05-27.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.87604.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 4.36/5 by 11 [4]

## Around the show

- Clarence Clemons sat in on several songs, one of multiple 1989 appearances; show was a shared benefit bill [8]
- Jerry speaks to the crowd after the encore [11]
- Reviewer cycled from Vancouver to the Bay Area; Tower of Power also played that day's full bill [18]
- Video of Fogerty, Garcia and Weir from this Oakland day can be found on YouTube [19]
- Clarence Clemons played sax from Iko Iko through Truckin', and on Lovelight and Brokedown Palace [2]
- Reviewer calls it fun but not epic, and not the best of 1989 [13]
- Recommends the 7/16/90 Blow Away as tighter, with amazing Jerry playing [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-05-27.pzm.russjcan.93686.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat-Mounted Realistic pzm's with Sony WMD6-C 50 feet away,dead center Maxell XLII S 90 No nr [1]. Also: Pzm-source copy had static removed in Goldwave on disc 3, and some left-channel sections replaced with right-channel mono [1]
- **gd1989-05-27.155314.ultramatrix.miller.flac24**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 12, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MA-XG90) [2]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several UltraMatrix masters combined to complete the show [2]
- **gd1989-05-27.155440.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 12, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MA-XG90) [3]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several UltraMatrix masters combined; this is a 24-bit/96... conversion down to 16-bit/44.1 [3]
- **gd1989-05-27.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.87604.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/Maxell MX90) D [4]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Vintage Concert Handbill from Oakland Coliseum Stadium, May 27, 1989 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/posters-handbills-and-postcards/grateful-dead/handbill/OCS890527.html) [21]
